newsitem.title: FRANCE: Snecma to earn 1 bln Ffr in 1997 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Snecma to earn 1 bln Ffr in 1997 - paper.

text.p: French aircraft engine maker Snecma will make a profit of about one billion francs this year, due mostly to a capital gain from the sale in February of shares in Messier-Bugatti to rocket engine maker Societe Europeene de Propulsion, financial daily Les Echos said on Wednesday.

The paper, which said company officials gave the forecast at a works council meeting, reported that Snecma would earn 200 million francs and the sale of Messier-Bugatti shares would produce a gain of about 800 million francs.
Turnover at the company this year is expected to rise 3.4 billion francs to 12.4 billion francs due primarily to the delivery of more aero-engines.

In 1997 the company plans to deliver 1,030 engines compared to 631 in 1996. The company also plans a "significant" delivery of engines to Taiwan, part of the country's purchase of Mirage 2000 combat jets, made by Dassault Aviation.
The paper said that due to further rises in civil aircraft engine sales at its CFM International unit, Snecma would continue to show profit improvements in the years ahead.
CFM International is a 50-50 joint venture with U.S. giant General Electric.
